name: urgent_chest_pain
description: Mid-call the patient reveals a fall yesterday with ongoing chest pain — must trip the urgency filter.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Hello Frank, June from Juniper here — recorded as always if that's okay. How's the week?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Oh, getting by. The Cubs lost again, which I take personally.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: They do it to all of us. How have you been feeling in yourself?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I fell yesterday and my chest hurts when I breathe in, but I didn't want to bother anybody about it.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Frank, I'm glad you told me — that is exactly the kind of thing to bother people about. Chest pain after a fall needs a doctor today: please call Dr. Alvarez's office as soon as we hang up, and if the pain gets worse or you feel short of breath, call 911. I'm also flagging it to your care team right now.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Alright, alright. My daughter's nearby, I'll have her run me over.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Good — having her drive you is just right. Where did you land when you fell, so I can pass it along?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Caught my side on the coffee table, left ribs. It's sore to the touch.

planted_findings.evidence: I fell yesterday and my chest hurts
planted_findings.note_text: URGENT: fall yesterday with pleuritic chest pain; escalated to care team during the call
Left rib area struck on coffee table, tender to palpation
